cliente: Universal · Blowtex · SKYN · Ração Max · Hits

valor.en: Copy by Rodrigo Mahs, Vitor Salgueiro and Leticia Chinelato

resumo.en: Feed posts, stories and TikToks for Universal, Blowtex, SKYN, Ração Max and Hits, animated and cut at Cappuccino.

desafio.en:
Social ships fast and in many formats. At Cappuccino I animated and edited pieces for five very different brands between 2024 and 2026, about a week each. Universal's Dia D needed teasers that hold a secret, and Minions & Monsters a story series with Kaká and Cafu for the 2026 World Cup.

Blowtex and SKYN sell condoms, so the posts had to be bold without turning vulgar. Ração Max wanted a pet telenovela. Hits needed nail colors that read in two seconds on TikTok.

processo.en:
For Dia D, coordinates of Varginha and Chapada dos Veadeiros glitch on screen and resolve into the release date. For Blowtex, a roller-coaster ride does the talking on Orgasm Day, and the Hot and long-lasting lines get type that lands on the beat. For Minions, I treated the stories as one sequence, so each one picks up where the last stops. Entre Patas e Lambeijos plays a one-minute novela for Ração Max, cut like a soap opera.

For Hits, each polish color meets a look, ending on the colors that will mark 2026. Every piece came from one master project, cut to feed, 9:16 stories, TikTok and short versions. On Dia D, Minions and Orgasm Day: creative direction by Diego Araujo Torres, art direction by Guilherme Oliveira and Mariana Benedito.

resultado.en: The Minions & Monsters campaign went 360. These five stories with Kaká and Cafu ran on Universal's social channels, while the same campaign played in cinemas and on TV.

alt.en: Montage cut between the pieces: Dia D, Minions, Blowtex, Ração Max, SKYN and Hits
